title: 8 April 2025 – To all National Spiritual Assemblies
author: Unknown

sections.title: Main
paragraphs: It is with hearts brimming with joy that we announce that the conditions in the Philippines now make it possible for a national Ma sh riqu’l-A dh kár to be raised up in the vicinity of Manila. The project to construct this edifice joins the six other Temple projects announced since the commencement of the Nine Year Plan.
